integrity: The published cyclic Hessian stratification and ten-node premise were checked in primary literature. The new scheme calculation is proved from the Jacobian ideal and verified on an exact Sylvester witness; genericity is obtained from explicit maximal-rank minors and openness.
scientific_limitations: The length-21 statement is for a nonempty Zariski-open subset of general cyclic cubic threefolds. Special cyclic cubics with extra Hessian degeneracies are excluded, and no primary decomposition of the embedded vertex structure beyond the saturation module is claimed.
title: A length-\(21\) embedded vertex defect in the Hessian singular scheme of a general cyclic cubic threefold
